user.title: BRINK Modbus connection
user.description: Select how Home Assistant connects to the BRINK unit.

data_description.connection_type: Use Modbus TCP for a TCP-to-RTU gateway. RTU-over-TCP is for transparent serial servers only.

connection.title: BRINK connection settings
connection.description: Monitoring-only is the safe default and does not write to the ventilation unit.

data_description.port: TCP port for gateways, or serial device path such as /dev/ttyUSB0.
data_description.baudrate: BRINK default: 19200, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit.
data_description.control_enabled: Enable only if you intentionally want Home Assistant to write settings. It never enables Modbus control automatically.
data_description.auto_control_mode: When enabled, setting a flow target or switch position first writes the matching Modbus control mode (register 8000). This lets Home Assistant retake control after a power loss resets the unit to Disabled.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the BRINK Modbus device.
error.invalid_input: Check the connection settings, host, TCP port, and slave ID.
error.invalid_response: The gateway connected, but the BRINK did not accept the read-only appliance-type request.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for details.
